1.mascotDialogue: Same visited-tracking idea as BFS, güey, completely different order! DFS dives deep first, only comes back up when it truly's gotta.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 6's the whole difference from BFS — instead of queuing the neighbor for later, DFS recurses into it right away, going deep before it ever checks the next sibling.

3.mascotDialogue: Same graph as the BFS lesson, completely different order — 3's visited before 2, 'cause DFS committed to 1 first, and rode that path all the way down!

4.mascotDialogue: DFS's recursive elegance is also its biggest risk — forget the visited check, and 'go deep' has no bottom to hit. It just keeps calling itself, forever, güey.
